const config = {
  name: "widget",

  compute(x: number): number {
    if (x > 10) {
      return x * 2;
    }
    return x;
  },

  get label(): string {
    return this.name;
  },

  set label(value: string) {
    if (value.length > 0) {
      this.name = value;
    }
  },

  [Symbol.iterator]: function () {
    return null;
  },

  onEvent: (evt: string) => {
    if (evt === "click" || evt === "tap") {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  },
};

const nested = {
  outer: {
    inner(x: number): number {
      if (x < 0) {
        return -x;
      }
      return x;
    },
  },
};
